create_reference_audio_frame: create a reference audio frame from a numpy array with sample format and sample rate
create_reference_video_frame: create a reference video frame from a numpy array with pixel format and frame rate
convert_frames: convert a reference audio or video frame into a buffer object
to_numpy: convert a frame buffer back into a numpy array for inspection
test_reference_frame_lifetime: test that reference frames keep the underlying numpy array alive until the frame is deleted
